corrupt_record_temporal_scope.verdict: Narrow scope is safe for intact serial ordering with in-place cancellation corruption, but cannot cover reordered/forward cancellation records: later target replays even when corrupt_records explicitly diagnoses it
corrupt_record_temporal_scope.scope: Forward cases move authentic cancellation before target (plus one-character edit in corrupt variant); not generated by current single-writer append protocol. No hash recomputed. Intact order controls and duplicate physical line remain fail-closed. Requires explicit corruption/order scope or whole-journal fencing.

torn_cancelled_record.verdict: OPEN Medium F-abort-tail: deleting only final newline from a durably successful cancellation silently revives it; copied-aside cancellation not considered by parser
torn_cancelled_record.scope: Single-byte newline loss needs neither target change nor record reordering nor recomputed hash. Whitespace replacement is a broader destructive-content control. Preserve forensic aside, but do not treat unknown/cancellation tail as authorization.
